{{recipesummary|Beverage recipes|servings=12 persons|time=30 minutes}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Chile|Cuisine of Chile]] | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]]

== Ingredients ==

* ¼ [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] of Chilean [[Cookbook:Brandy|brandy]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] sticks
* 4 spoonfuls [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] water
* 9 cups (2.1 L) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 12 spoonfuls [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

== Preparation ==
# Mix the nutmeg, the cloves and the cinnamon in a small pot with the water. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the mixture for 10 minutes.
# If desired, take remove the spices from the water, although it is better to leave them there.
# Transfer the water into a pot with a capacity of 3 liters.
# Add the coffee along with some more water and sugar.
# As soon as the sugar gets dissolved, add the rest of the milk and the Chilean brandy.
# Bottle the Cola de Mono and put it in the refrigerator.
